                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>

                        </StackPanel>

                    </StackPanel>
                </ScrollViewer>

            </DockPanel>
        </Grid>
    </DockPanel>
</Window>

<Window x:Class="ABLogixGitManager.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.ViewModels"
        xmlns:conv="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Converters"
        xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Controls"
        Title="AB Logix Git Manager"
        Width="960" Height="680"
        MinWidth="780" MinHeight="520"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen">

    <Window.DataContext>
        <vm:MainViewModel/>
    </Window.DataContext>

    <Window.Resources>
        <conv:BoolInverterConverter x:Key="BoolInverter"/>
    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             TOP BAR  —  title + l5xgit.exe path
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#1E1E2E" Padding="14,9">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="🔧" FontSize="16" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="AB Logix Git Manager"
                               Foreground="White" FontSize="15" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                <!-- l5xgit.exe path control -->
                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe:" Foreground="#AAAAAA" FontSize="12" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBox x:Name="L5xGitPathBox"
                             Text="{Binding L5xGitExePath, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                             Width="300"
                             Background="#2D2D3F" Foreground="#E0E0E0"
                             BorderBrush="#555566" Padding="6,4"
                             FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                             VerticalContentAlignment="Center"
                             ToolTip="Full path to l5xgit.exe (built from ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools)"/>
                    <Button Content="Browse"
                            Click="BrowseL5xGit_Click"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="Save"
                            Command="{Binding SaveL5xGitPathCommand}"
                            Background="#2EA043" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="⚙ Settings"
                            Command="{Binding OpenSettingsCommand}"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             STATUS BAR  —  bottom
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

                BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0" Padding="12,4">
            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12">
                    <TextBlock.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                            <Setter Property="Text" Value="Ready"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#444"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Text" Value="⏳  Operation in progress…  Please wait."/>
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#B36A00"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </TextBlock.Style>
                </TextBlock>
                <ProgressBar IsIndeterminate="True" Width="120" Height="10"
                             VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <ProgressBar.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="ProgressBar">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>

        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

                <ColumnDefinition Width="4"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>

                            Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"/>
                </Border>

                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Padding="8,6"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">

                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>

                                Style="{StaticResource DangerButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>

                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}"
                                               FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13"
                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding AcdFilePath}"
                                               FontSize="10" Foreground="#888"
                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                               Margin="0,2,0,0"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                </ListBox>
            </DockPanel>

            <!-- Splitter -->
            <GridSplitter Grid.Column="1" Width="4"
                          HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" Background="#DDDDDD"/>

            <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                 RIGHT PANEL  —  actions + log
            ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
            <DockPanel Grid.Column="2">

                <!-- Log panel (fixed at bottom) -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#1E1E1E" Height="180">

                                    BorderThickness="0" Padding="8,2"
                                    FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                        </DockPanel>

                        <!-- Log text (auto-scrolls via code-behind) -->
                        <ScrollViewer x:Name="LogScrollViewer"
                                      VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                      HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                            <TextBox x:Name="LogTextBox"
                                     Text="{Binding LogOutput, Mode=OneWay}"
                                     IsReadOnly="True"
                                     Background="Transparent"
                                     Foreground="#90EE90"
                                     FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                                     BorderThickness="0"
                                     TextWrapping="NoWrap"
                                     Padding="10,4"/>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </DockPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Action area (scrollable) -->

                    <StackPanel Margin="20,16,20,16" Spacing="14">

                        <!-- ·····  PLACEHOLDER when nothing selected  ····· -->

                                   TextAlignment="Center" Foreground="#AAAAAA">
                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </TextBlock.Style>
                            <Run Text="Select a repo from the list" FontSize="14" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                            <LineBreak/>
                            <Run Text="or click  + Add Repo  to get started." FontSize="12"/>
                        </TextBlock>

                        <!-- ·····  CONTENT when a repo is selected  ····· -->
                        <StackPanel Spacing="14">
                            <StackPanel.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="StackPanel">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </StackPanel.Style>

                            <!-- Repo info card -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Background="#F0F4FF">
                                <StackPanel Spacing="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.Name}"
                                               FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#1E1E2E"/>
                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="ACD:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.AcdFilePath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="Repo:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.GitRepoPath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <!-- ── COMMIT CARD ── -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <StackPanel Spacing="10">
                                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                               Text="📤  COMMIT ACD TO GIT"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#666" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Exports the ACD, converts to L5X, explodes to XML/ST files, then
                                        stages and commits all changes to the git repository.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding CommitMessage, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                             AcceptsReturn="True"
                                             Height="80"
                                             TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                             VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             FontSize="13"
                                             BorderBrush="#C0C0C0"
                                             PlaceholderText="Enter a commit message…"
                                             IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                    <Button Content="  ↑  Commit to Git  "
                                            Command="{Binding CommitCommand}"

<Window x:Class="ABLogixGitManager.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.ViewModels"
        xmlns:conv="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Converters"
        xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Controls"
        Title="AB Logix Git Manager"
        Width="960" Height="680"
        MinWidth="780" MinHeight="520"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen">

    <Window.DataContext>
        <vm:MainViewModel/>
    </Window.DataContext>

    <Window.Resources>
        <conv:BoolInverterConverter x:Key="BoolInverter"/>
    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             TOP BAR  —  title + l5xgit.exe path
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#1E1E2E" Padding="14,9">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="🔧" FontSize="16" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="AB Logix Git Manager"
                               Foreground="White" FontSize="15" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                <!-- l5xgit.exe path control -->
                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe:" Foreground="#AAAAAA" FontSize="12" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBox x:Name="L5xGitPathBox"
                             Text="{Binding L5xGitExePath, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                             Width="300"
                             Background="#2D2D3F" Foreground="#E0E0E0"
                             BorderBrush="#555566" Padding="6,4"
                             FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                             VerticalContentAlignment="Center"
                             ToolTip="Full path to l5xgit.exe (built from ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools)"/>
                    <Button Content="Browse"
                            Click="BrowseL5xGit_Click"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="Save"
                            Command="{Binding SaveL5xGitPathCommand}"
                            Background="#2EA043" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="⚙ Settings"
                            Command="{Binding OpenSettingsCommand}"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             STATUS BAR  —  bottom
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#F3F3F3"
                BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0" Padding="12,4">
            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12">
                    <TextBlock.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                            <Setter Property="Text" Value="Ready"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#444"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Text" Value="⏳  Operation in progress…  Please wait."/>
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#B36A00"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </TextBlock.Style>
                </TextBlock>
                <ProgressBar IsIndeterminate="True" Width="120" Height="10"
                             VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <ProgressBar.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="ProgressBar">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </ProgressBar.Style>
                </ProgressBar>
            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             MAIN AREA  —  left list + right detail
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Grid>
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="230" MinWidth="160"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="4"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                 LEFT PANEL  —  repo list
            ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
            <DockPanel Grid.Column="0" Background="#F7F7F7">

                <!-- Add button -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Padding="10,8"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                    <Button Content="+ Add Repo"
                            Command="{Binding AddRepoCommand}"
                            Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"/>
                </Border>

                <!-- Edit / Remove buttons -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Padding="8,6"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">
                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                        <Button Content="Edit"
                                Command="{Binding EditRepoCommand}"
                                Style="{StaticResource NeutralButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                        <Button Content="Remove"
                                Command="{Binding RemoveRepoCommand}"
                                Style="{StaticResource DangerButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Repo list -->
                <ListBox ItemsSource="{Binding Repos}"
                         SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedRepo}"
                         BorderThickness="0"
                         Background="Transparent"
                         ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                    <ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                        <Style TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
                            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#DDEEFF"/>
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#EEF5FF"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                    <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <Border Padding="10,8"
                                    BorderBrush="#E5E5E5" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}"
                                               FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13"
                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding AcdFilePath}"
                                               FontSize="10" Foreground="#888"
                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                               Margin="0,2,0,0"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                </ListBox>
            </DockPanel>

            <!-- Splitter -->
            <GridSplitter Grid.Column="1" Width="4"
                          HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" Background="#DDDDDD"/>

            <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                 RIGHT PANEL  —  actions + log
            ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
            <DockPanel Grid.Column="2">

                <!-- Log panel (fixed at bottom) -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#1E1E1E" Height="180">
                    <DockPanel>
                        <!-- Log toolbar -->
                        <DockPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="10,6">
                            <TextBlock Text="OUTPUT LOG"
                                       Foreground="#888888" FontSize="10"
                                       FontWeight="Bold" FontFamily="Consolas"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            <Button Content="Clear"
                                    Command="{Binding ClearLogCommand}"
                                    DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                    Background="#3A3A3A" Foreground="#BBBBBB"
                                    BorderThickness="0" Padding="8,2"
                                    FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                        </DockPanel>

                        <!-- Log text (auto-scrolls via code-behind) -->
                        <ScrollViewer x:Name="LogScrollViewer"
                                      VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                      HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                            <TextBox x:Name="LogTextBox"
                                     Text="{Binding LogOutput, Mode=OneWay}"
                                     IsReadOnly="True"
                                     Background="Transparent"
                                     Foreground="#90EE90"
                                     FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                                     BorderThickness="0"
                                     TextWrapping="NoWrap"
                                     Padding="10,4"/>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </DockPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Action area (scrollable) -->
                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" Background="#FAFAFA">
                    <StackPanel Margin="20,16,20,16" Spacing="14">

                        <!-- ·····  PLACEHOLDER when nothing selected  ····· -->
                        <TextBlock HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,40,0,0"
                                   TextAlignment="Center" Foreground="#AAAAAA">
                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </TextBlock.Style>
                            <Run Text="Select a repo from the list" FontSize="14" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                            <LineBreak/>
                            <Run Text="or click  + Add Repo  to get started." FontSize="12"/>
                        </TextBlock>

                        <!-- ·····  CONTENT when a repo is selected  ····· -->
                        <StackPanel Spacing="14">
                            <StackPanel.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="StackPanel">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </StackPanel.Style>

                            <!-- Repo info card -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Background="#F0F4FF">
                                <StackPanel Spacing="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.Name}"
                                               FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#1E1E2E"/>
                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="ACD:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.AcdFilePath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="Repo:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.GitRepoPath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <!-- ── COMMIT CARD ── -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <StackPanel Spacing="10">
                                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                               Text="📤  COMMIT ACD TO GIT"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#666" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Exports the ACD, converts to L5X, explodes to XML/ST files, then
                                        stages and commits all changes to the git repository.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding CommitMessage, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                             AcceptsReturn="True"
                                             Height="80"
                                             TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                             VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             FontSize="13"
                                             BorderBrush="#C0C0C0"
                                             PlaceholderText="Enter a commit message…"
                                             IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                    <Button Content="  ↑  Commit to Git  "
                                            Command="{Binding CommitCommand}"
                                            Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <!-- ── PULL & RESTORE CARD ── -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <StackPanel Spacing="10">
                                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                               Text="📥  PULL & RESTORE ACD"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#666" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Pulls the latest changes from the remote repository, then implodes
                                        the exploded files and converts back to a Logix ACD file.
                                        The existing ACD will be backed up before overwriting.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                    <Button Content="  ↓  Pull & Restore ACD  "
                                            Command="{Binding PullAndRestoreCommand}"
                                            Style="{StaticResource SuccessButton}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>

                        </StackPanel>

                    </StackPanel>
                </ScrollViewer>

            </DockPanel>
        </Grid>
    </DockPanel>
</Window>

<Window x:Class="ABLogixGitManager.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.ViewModels"
        xmlns:conv="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Converters"
        xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Controls"
        Title="AB Logix Git Manager"
        Width="960" Height="680"
        MinWidth="780" MinHeight="520"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen">

    <Window.DataContext>
        <vm:MainViewModel/>
    </Window.DataContext>

    <Window.Resources>
        <conv:BoolInverterConverter x:Key="BoolInverter"/>
    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             TOP BAR  —  title + l5xgit.exe path
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#1E1E2E" Padding="14,9">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="🔧" FontSize="16" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="AB Logix Git Manager"
                               Foreground="White" FontSize="15" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                <!-- l5xgit.exe path control -->
                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe:" Foreground="#AAAAAA" FontSize="12" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBox x:Name="L5xGitPathBox"
                             Text="{Binding L5xGitExePath, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                             Width="300"
                             Background="#2D2D3F" Foreground="#E0E0E0"
                             BorderBrush="#555566" Padding="6,4"
                             FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                             VerticalContentAlignment="Center"
                             ToolTip="Full path to l5xgit.exe (built from ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools)"/>
                    <Button Content="Browse"
                            Click="BrowseL5xGit_Click"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="Save"
                            Command="{Binding SaveL5xGitPathCommand}"
                            Background="#2EA043" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="⚙ Settings"
                            Command="{Binding OpenSettingsCommand}"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             STATUS BAR  —  bottom
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#F3F3F3"
                BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0" Padding="12,4">
            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12">
                    <TextBlock.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                            <Setter Property="Text" Value="Ready"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#444"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Text" Value="⏳  Operation in progress…  Please wait."/>
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#B36A00"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </TextBlock.Style>
                </TextBlock>
                <ProgressBar IsIndeterminate="True" Width="120" Height="10"
                             VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <ProgressBar.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="ProgressBar">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </ProgressBar.Style>
                </ProgressBar>
            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             MAIN AREA  —  left list + right detail
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Grid>
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="230" MinWidth="160"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="4"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                 LEFT PANEL  —  repo list
            ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
            <DockPanel Grid.Column="0" Background="#F7F7F7">

                <!-- Add button -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Padding="10,8"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                    <Button Content="+ Add Repo"
                            Command="{Binding AddRepoCommand}"
                            Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"/>
                </Border>

                <!-- Edit / Remove buttons -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Padding="8,6"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">
                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                        <Button Content="Edit"
                                Command="{Binding EditRepoCommand}"
                                Style="{StaticResource NeutralButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                        <Button Content="Remove"
                                Command="{Binding RemoveRepoCommand}"
                                Style="{StaticResource DangerButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Repo list -->
                <ListBox ItemsSource="{Binding Repos}"
                         SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedRepo}"
                         BorderThickness="0"
                         Background="Transparent"
                         ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                    <ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                        <Style TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
                            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#DDEEFF"/>
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#EEF5FF"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                    <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <Border Padding="10,8"
                                    BorderBrush="#E5E5E5" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}"
                                               FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13"
                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding AcdFilePath}"
                                               FontSize="10" Foreground="#888"
                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                               Margin="0,2,0,0"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                </ListBox>
            </DockPanel>

            <!-- Splitter -->
            <GridSplitter Grid.Column="1" Width="4"
                          HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" Background="#DDDDDD"/>

            <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                 RIGHT PANEL  —  actions + log
            ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
            <DockPanel Grid.Column="2">

                <!-- Log panel (fixed at bottom) -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#1E1E1E" Height="180">
                    <DockPanel>
                        <!-- Log toolbar -->
                        <DockPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="10,6">
                            <TextBlock Text="OUTPUT LOG"
                                       Foreground="#888888" FontSize="10"
                                       FontWeight="Bold" FontFamily="Consolas"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            <Button Content="Clear"
                                    Command="{Binding ClearLogCommand}"
                                    DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                    Background="#3A3A3A" Foreground="#BBBBBB"
                                    BorderThickness="0" Padding="8,2"
                                    FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                        </DockPanel>

                        <!-- Log text (auto-scrolls via code-behind) -->
                        <ScrollViewer x:Name="LogScrollViewer"
                                      VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                      HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                            <TextBox x:Name="LogTextBox"
                                     Text="{Binding LogOutput, Mode=OneWay}"
                                     IsReadOnly="True"
                                     Background="Transparent"
                                     Foreground="#90EE90"
                                     FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                                     BorderThickness="0"
                                     TextWrapping="NoWrap"
                                     Padding="10,4"/>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </DockPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Action area (scrollable) -->
                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" Background="#FAFAFA">
                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Margin="20,16,20,16" Spacing="14">

                        <!-- ·····  Setup warning when l5xgit.exe is not configured  ····· -->
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Background="#FFF8E1"
                                BorderBrush="#FFD54F">
                            <Border.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="Border" BasedOn="{StaticResource Card}">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsL5xGitConfigured}" Value="False">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </Border.Style>
                            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="10">
                                <TextBlock Text="⚠️" FontSize="18" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe not configured" FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13" Foreground="#6D4C00"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#6D4C00" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Browse to l5xgit.exe above and click Save, or open ⚙ Settings to check all dependencies.
                                        Commit and Restore are disabled until configured.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                        </Border>

                        <!-- ·····  PLACEHOLDER when nothing selected  ····· -->
                        <TextBlock HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,40,0,0"
                                   TextAlignment="Center" Foreground="#AAAAAA">
                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </TextBlock.Style>
                            <Run Text="Select a repo from the list" FontSize="14" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                            <LineBreak/>
                            <Run Text="or click  + Add Repo  to get started." FontSize="12"/>
                        </TextBlock>

                        <!-- ·····  CONTENT when a repo is selected  ····· -->
                        <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="14">
                            <controls:SpacedStackPanel.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="{x:Type controls:SpacedStackPanel}">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </controls:SpacedStackPanel.Style>

                            <!-- Repo info card -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Background="#F0F4FF">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.Name}"
                                               FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#1E1E2E"/>
                                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="ACD:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.AcdFilePath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="Repo:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.GitRepoPath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <!-- ── COMMIT CARD ── -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="10">
                                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                               Text="📤  COMMIT ACD TO GIT"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#666" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Exports the ACD, converts to L5X, explodes to XML/ST files, then
                                        stages and commits all changes to the git repository.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding CommitMessage, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                             AcceptsReturn="True"
                                             Height="80"
                                             TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                             VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             FontSize="13"
                                             BorderBrush="#C0C0C0"
                                             PlaceholderText="Enter a commit message…"
                                             IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                    <Button Content="  ↑  Commit to Git  "
                                            Command="{Binding CommitCommand}"
                                            Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <!-- ── PULL & RESTORE CARD ── -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="10">
                                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                               Text="📥  PULL & RESTORE ACD"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#666" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Pulls the latest changes from the remote repository, then implodes
                                        the exploded files and converts back to a Logix ACD file.
                                        The existing ACD will be overwritten. Any backup behavior depends
                                        on the external l5xgit tool and has not been validated by this
                                        application. Restore will not proceed if git pull fails.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                    <Button Content="  ↓  Pull & Restore ACD  "
                                            Command="{Binding PullAndRestoreCommand}"
                                            Style="{StaticResource SuccessButton}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                        </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                </ScrollViewer>

            </DockPanel>
        </Grid>
    </DockPanel>
</Window>

<Window x:Class="ABLogixGitManager.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.ViewModels"
        xmlns:conv="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Converters"
        xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Controls"
        Title="AB Logix Git Manager"
        Width="960" Height="680"
        MinWidth="780" MinHeight="520"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen">

    <Window.DataContext>
        <vm:MainViewModel/>
    </Window.DataContext>

    <Window.Resources>
        <conv:BoolInverterConverter x:Key="BoolInverter"/>
    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             TOP BAR  —  title + l5xgit.exe path
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#1E1E2E" Padding="14,9">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="🔧" FontSize="16" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="AB Logix Git Manager"
                               Foreground="White" FontSize="15" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                <!-- l5xgit.exe path control -->
                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe:" Foreground="#AAAAAA" FontSize="12" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBox x:Name="L5xGitPathBox"
                             Text="{Binding L5xGitExePath, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                             Width="300"
                             Background="#2D2D3F" Foreground="#E0E0E0"
                             BorderBrush="#555566" Padding="6,4"
                             FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                             VerticalContentAlignment="Center"
                             ToolTip="Full path to l5xgit.exe (built from ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools)"/>
                    <Button Content="Browse"
                            Click="BrowseL5xGit_Click"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="Save"
                            Command="{Binding SaveL5xGitPathCommand}"
                            Background="#2EA043" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="⚙ Settings"
                            Command="{Binding OpenSettingsCommand}"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             STATUS BAR  —  bottom
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#F3F3F3"
                BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0" Padding="12,4">
            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12">
                    <TextBlock.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                            <Setter Property="Text" Value="Ready"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#444"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Text" Value="⏳  Operation in progress…  Please wait."/>
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#B36A00"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </TextBlock.Style>
                </TextBlock>
                <ProgressBar IsIndeterminate="True" Width="120" Height="10"
                             VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <ProgressBar.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="ProgressBar">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </ProgressBar.Style>
                </ProgressBar>
            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             MAIN AREA  —  left list + right detail
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Grid>
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="230" MinWidth="160"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="4"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                 LEFT PANEL  —  repo list
            ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
            <DockPanel Grid.Column="0" Background="#F7F7F7">

                <!-- Add button -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Padding="10,8"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                    <Button Content="+ Add Repo"
                            Command="{Binding AddRepoCommand}"
                            Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"/>
                </Border>

                <!-- Edit / Remove buttons -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Padding="8,6"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">
                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                        <Button Content="Edit"
                                Command="{Binding EditRepoCommand}"
                                Style="{StaticResource NeutralButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                        <Button Content="Remove"
                                Command="{Binding RemoveRepoCommand}"
                                Style="{StaticResource DangerButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Repo list -->
                <ListBox ItemsSource="{Binding Repos}"
                         SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedRepo}"
                         BorderThickness="0"
                         Background="Transparent"
                         ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                    <ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                        <Style TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
                            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#DDEEFF"/>
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#EEF5FF"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                    <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <Border Padding="10,8"
                                    BorderBrush="#E5E5E5" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}"
                                               FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13"
                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding AcdFilePath}"
                                               FontSize="10" Foreground="#888"
                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                               Margin="0,2,0,0"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                </ListBox>
            </DockPanel>

            <!-- Splitter -->
            <GridSplitter Grid.Column="1" Width="4"
                          HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" Background="#DDDDDD"/>

            <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                 RIGHT PANEL  —  actions + log
            ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
            <DockPanel Grid.Column="2">

                <!-- Log panel (fixed at bottom) -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#1E1E1E" Height="180">
                    <DockPanel>
                        <!-- Log toolbar -->
                        <DockPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="10,6">
                            <TextBlock Text="OUTPUT LOG"
                                       Foreground="#888888" FontSize="10"
                                       FontWeight="Bold" FontFamily="Consolas"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            <Button Content="Clear"
                                    Command="{Binding ClearLogCommand}"
                                    DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                    Background="#3A3A3A" Foreground="#BBBBBB"
                                    BorderThickness="0" Padding="8,2"
                                    FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                        </DockPanel>

                        <!-- Log text (auto-scrolls via code-behind) -->
                        <ScrollViewer x:Name="LogScrollViewer"
                                      VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                      HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                            <TextBox x:Name="LogTextBox"
                                     Text="{Binding LogOutput, Mode=OneWay}"
                                     IsReadOnly="True"
                                     Background="Transparent"
                                     Foreground="#90EE90"
                                     FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                                     BorderThickness="0"
                                     TextWrapping="NoWrap"
                                     Padding="10,4"/>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </DockPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Action area (scrollable) -->
                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" Background="#FAFAFA">
                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Margin="20,16,20,16" Spacing="14">

                        <!-- ·····  Setup warning when l5xgit.exe is not configured  ····· -->
                        <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Background="#FFF8E1"
                                BorderBrush="#FFD54F">
                            <Border.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="Border" BasedOn="{StaticResource Card}">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsL5xGitConfigured}" Value="False">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </Border.Style>
                            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="10">
                                <TextBlock Text="⚠️" FontSize="18" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe not configured" FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13" Foreground="#6D4C00"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#6D4C00" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Browse to l5xgit.exe above and click Save, or open ⚙ Settings to check all dependencies.
                                        Commit and Restore are disabled until configured.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                        </Border>

                        <!-- ·····  PLACEHOLDER when nothing selected  ····· -->
                        <TextBlock HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,40,0,0"
                                   TextAlignment="Center" Foreground="#AAAAAA">
                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </TextBlock.Style>
                            <Run Text="Select a repo from the list" FontSize="14" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                            <LineBreak/>
                            <Run Text="or click  + Add Repo  to get started." FontSize="12"/>
                        </TextBlock>

                        <!-- ·····  CONTENT when a repo is selected  ····· -->
                        <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="14">
                            <controls:SpacedStackPanel.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="{x:Type controls:SpacedStackPanel}">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </controls:SpacedStackPanel.Style>

                            <!-- Repo info card -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Background="#F0F4FF">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.Name}"
                                               FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#1E1E2E"/>
                                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="ACD:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.AcdFilePath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="Repo:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.GitRepoPath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <!-- ── COMMIT CARD ── -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="10">
                                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                               Text="📤  COMMIT ACD TO GIT"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#666" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Exports the ACD, converts to L5X, explodes to XML/ST files, then
                                        stages and commits all changes to the git repository.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding CommitMessage, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                             AcceptsReturn="True"
                                             Height="80"
                                             TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                             VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             FontSize="13"
                                             BorderBrush="#C0C0C0"
                                             PlaceholderText="Enter a commit message…"
                                             IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                    <Button Content="  ↑  Commit to Git  "
                                            Command="{Binding CommitCommand}"
                                            Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <!-- ── PULL & RESTORE CARD ── -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="10">
                                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                               Text="📥  PULL & RESTORE ACD"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#666" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Pulls the latest changes from the remote repository, then implodes
                                        the exploded files and converts back to a Logix ACD file.
                                        The existing ACD will be overwritten. Any backup behavior depends
                                        on the external l5xgit tool and has not been validated by this
                                        application. Restore will not proceed if git pull fails.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                    <Button Content="  ↓  Pull & Restore ACD  "
                                            Command="{Binding PullAndRestoreCommand}"
                                            Style="{StaticResource SuccessButton}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                        </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                </ScrollViewer>

            </DockPanel>
        </Grid>
    </DockPanel>
</Window>

            <Button Grid.Row="7" Grid.Column="1" Content="Browse…"

+/// <summary>
+/// Converts a <see cref="DependencyStatus"/> value to a display icon string (emoji).
+/// </summary>
+[ValueConversion(typeof(DependencyStatus), typeof(string))]
+public class DependencyStatusToIconConverter : IValueConverter
+{
+    public static readonly DependencyStatusToIconConverter Instance = new();
+
+    public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) =>
+        value is DependencyStatus status ? StatusIcon(status) : "❓";
+
+    public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) =>
+        throw new NotSupportedException();
+
+    private static string StatusIcon(DependencyStatus status) => status switch

+        DependencyStatus.Ready         => "✅",
+        DependencyStatus.Missing       => "⚠️",
+        DependencyStatus.Incompatible  => "⚠️",
+        DependencyStatus.Scanning      => "⏳",
+        DependencyStatus.Failed        => "❌",
+        DependencyStatus.AdminRequired => "🔒",
+        _                              => "❓",
+    };
+}

+    public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) =>
+        throw new NotSupportedException();

+}
