<Window x:Class="ABLogixGitManager.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.ViewModels"
        xmlns:conv="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Converters"
        xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Controls"
        Title="AB Logix Git Manager"
        Width="960" Height="680"
        MinWidth="780" MinHeight="520"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen">

    <Window.DataContext>
        <vm:MainViewModel/>
    </Window.DataContext>

    <Window.Resources>
        <conv:BoolInverterConverter x:Key="BoolInverter"/>
    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             TOP BAR  —  title + l5xgit.exe path
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#1E1E2E" Padding="14,9">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="🔧" FontSize="16" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="AB Logix Git Manager"
                               Foreground="White" FontSize="15" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                <!-- l5xgit.exe path control -->
                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe:" Foreground="#AAAAAA" FontSize="12" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBox x:Name="L5xGitPathBox"
                             Text="{Binding L5xGitExePath, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                             Width="300"
                             Background="#2D2D3F" Foreground="#E0E0E0"
                             BorderBrush="#555566" Padding="6,4"
                             FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                             VerticalContentAlignment="Center"
                             ToolTip="Full path to l5xgit.exe (built from ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools)"/>
                    <Button Content="Browse"
                            Click="BrowseL5xGit_Click"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="Save"
                            Command="{Binding SaveL5xGitPathCommand}"
                            Background="#2EA043" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="⚙ Settings"
                            Command="{Binding OpenSettingsCommand}"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             STATUS BAR  —  bottom
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#F3F3F3"
                BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0" Padding="12,4">
            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12">
                    <TextBlock.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                            <Setter Property="Text" Value="Ready"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#444"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Text" Value="⏳  Operation in progress…  Please wait."/>
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#B36A00"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </TextBlock.Style>
                </TextBlock>
                <ProgressBar IsIndeterminate="True" Width="120" Height="10"
                             VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <ProgressBar.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="ProgressBar">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </ProgressBar.Style>
                </ProgressBar>
            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             MAIN AREA  —  left list + right detail
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Grid>
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="230" MinWidth="160"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="4"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                 LEFT PANEL  —  repo list
            ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
            <DockPanel Grid.Column="0" Background="#F7F7F7">

                <!-- Add button -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Padding="10,8"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                    <Button Content="+ Add Repo"
                            Command="{Binding AddRepoCommand}"
                            Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"/>
                </Border>

                <!-- Edit / Remove buttons -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Padding="8,6"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">
                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                        <Button Content="Edit"
                                Command="{Binding EditRepoCommand}"
                                Style="{StaticResource NeutralButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                        <Button Content="Remove"
                                Command="{Binding RemoveRepoCommand}"
                                Style="{StaticResource DangerButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Repo list -->
                <ListBox ItemsSource="{Binding Repos}"
                         SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedRepo}"
                         BorderThickness="0"
                         Background="Transparent"
                         ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                    <ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                        <Style TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
                            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#DDEEFF"/>
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#EEF5FF"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                    <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <Border Padding="10,8"
                                    BorderBrush="#E5E5E5" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}"
                                               FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13"
                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding AcdFilePath}"
                                               FontSize="10" Foreground="#888"
                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                               Margin="0,2,0,0"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                </ListBox>
            </DockPanel>

            <!-- Splitter -->
            <GridSplitter Grid.Column="1" Width="4"
                          HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" Background="#DDDDDD"/>

            <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                 RIGHT PANEL  —  actions + log
            ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
            <DockPanel Grid.Column="2">

                <!-- Log panel (fixed at bottom) -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#1E1E1E" Height="180">
                    <DockPanel>
                        <!-- Log toolbar -->
                        <DockPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="10,6">
                            <TextBlock Text="OUTPUT LOG"
                                       Foreground="#888888" FontSize="10"
                                       FontWeight="Bold" FontFamily="Consolas"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            <Button Content="Clear"
                                    Command="{Binding ClearLogCommand}"
                                    DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                    Background="#3A3A3A" Foreground="#BBBBBB"
                                    BorderThickness="0" Padding="8,2"
                                    FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                        </DockPanel>

                        <!-- Log text (auto-scrolls via code-behind) -->
                        <ScrollViewer x:Name="LogScrollViewer"
                                      VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                      HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                            <TextBox x:Name="LogTextBox"
                                     Text="{Binding LogOutput, Mode=OneWay}"
                                     IsReadOnly="True"
                                     Background="Transparent"
                                     Foreground="#90EE90"
                                     FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                                     BorderThickness="0"
                                     TextWrapping="NoWrap"
                                     Padding="10,4"/>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </DockPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Action area (scrollable) -->
                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" Background="#FAFAFA">
                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Margin="20,16,20,16" Spacing="14">

                        <!-- ·····  Setup warning when l5xgit.exe is not configured  ····· -->
                        <Border>
                            <Border.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="Border" BasedOn="{StaticResource Card}">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#FFF8E1"/>
                                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#FFD54F"/>
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsL5xGitConfigured}" Value="False">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </Border.Style>
                            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="10">
                                <TextBlock Text="⚠️" FontSize="18" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe not configured" FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13" Foreground="#6D4C00"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#6D4C00" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Browse to l5xgit.exe above and click Save, or open ⚙ Settings to check all dependencies.
                                        Commit and Restore are disabled until configured.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                        </Border>

                        <!-- ·····  PLACEHOLDER when nothing selected  ····· -->
                        <TextBlock HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,40,0,0"
                                   TextAlignment="Center" Foreground="#AAAAAA">
                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </TextBlock.Style>
                            <Run Text="Select a repo from the list" FontSize="14" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                            <LineBreak/>
                            <Run Text="or click  + Add Repo  to get started." FontSize="12"/>
                        </TextBlock>

                        <!-- ·····  CONTENT when a repo is selected  ····· -->
                        <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="14">
                            <controls:SpacedStackPanel.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="{x:Type controls:SpacedStackPanel}">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </controls:SpacedStackPanel.Style>

                            <!-- Repo info card -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Background="#F0F4FF">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.Name}"
                                               FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#1E1E2E"/>
                                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="ACD:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.AcdFilePath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="Repo:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.GitRepoPath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <!-- ── COMMIT CARD ── -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="10">
                                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                               Text="📤  COMMIT ACD TO GIT"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#666" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Exports the ACD, converts to L5X, explodes to XML/ST files, then
                                        stages and commits all changes to the git repository.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding CommitMessage, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                             AcceptsReturn="True"
                                             Height="80"
                                             TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                             VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             FontSize="13"
                                             BorderBrush="#C0C0C0"
                                             IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                    <Button Content="  ↑  Commit to Git  "
                                            Command="{Binding CommitCommand}"
                                            Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <!-- ── PULL & RESTORE CARD ── -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="10">
                                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                               Text="📥  PULL & RESTORE ACD"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#666" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Pulls the latest changes from the remote repository, then implodes
                                        the exploded files and converts back to a Logix ACD file.
                                        The existing ACD will be overwritten. Any backup behavior depends
                                        on the external l5xgit tool and has not been validated by this
                                        application. Restore will not proceed if git pull fails.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                    <Button Content="  ↓  Pull & Restore ACD  "
                                            Command="{Binding PullAndRestoreCommand}"
                                            Style="{StaticResource SuccessButton}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                        </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                </ScrollViewer>

            </DockPanel>
        </Grid>
    </DockPanel>
</Window>

        </Grid>

<Window x:Class="ABLogixGitManager.Views.SettingsWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:conv="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Converters"
        xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Controls"
        Title="Settings — AB Logix Git Manager"
        Width="680" Height="520"
        MinWidth="560" MinHeight="420"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner"
        ResizeMode="CanResize"
        ShowInTaskbar="False">

    <Window.Resources>
        <conv:DependencyStatusToIconConverter  x:Key="StatusIcon"/>
        <conv:DependencyStatusToColorConverter x:Key="StatusColor"/>
        <conv:BoolInverterConverter             x:Key="BoolInverter"/>
    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel Margin="16">

        <!-- Close button at the bottom -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Margin="0,12,0,0">
            <Button Content="Close"
                    Click="Close_Click"
                    HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                    Background="#6C757D" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                    Padding="20,6" FontSize="13" Cursor="Hand">
                <Button.Template>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Border x:Name="border"
                                Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                CornerRadius="3"
                                Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="border" Property="Opacity" Value="0.85"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Button.Template>
            </Button>
        </Border>

        <!-- Main content -->
        <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="16">

            <!-- ── DEPENDENCY CENTER header ── -->
            <DockPanel>
                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock Text="DEPENDENCY CENTER"
                               FontSize="11" FontWeight="Bold"
                               Foreground="#555" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding ScanStatus}"
                               FontSize="11" Foreground="#888" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                <Button Content="↺  Rescan"
                        Command="{Binding RescanCommand}"
                        IsEnabled="{Binding IsScanning, Converter={StaticResource {x:Type conv:BoolInverterConverter}}}"
                        DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                        Background="#0078D4" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                        Padding="12,5" FontSize="12" Cursor="Hand">
                    <Button.Template>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                            <Border x:Name="border"
                                    Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                    CornerRadius="3"
                                    Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                                <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            </Border>
                            <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                    <Setter TargetName="border" Property="Opacity" Value="0.85"/>
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                                    <Setter TargetName="border" Property="Opacity" Value="0.45"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Button.Template>
                </Button>
            </DockPanel>

            <!-- ── Dependency list ── -->
            <Border BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4">
                <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Dependencies}">
                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <Border Padding="12,10"
                                    BorderBrush="#EEEEEE" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="12">
                                    <!-- Status icon -->
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Status, Converter={StaticResource StatusIcon}}"
                                               FontSize="18" VerticalAlignment="Top" Margin="0,2,0,0"/>

                                    <!-- Details -->
                                    <StackPanel>
                                        <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}"
                                                       FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13"
                                                       Foreground="#1E1E2E"/>
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Version}"
                                                       FontSize="12" Foreground="#888"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                <TextBlock.Style>
                                                    <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                        <Style.Triggers>
                                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Version}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                            </DataTrigger>
                                                        </Style.Triggers>
                                                    </Style>
                                                </TextBlock.Style>
                                            </TextBlock>
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Status}"
                                                       FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                       Foreground="{Binding Status, Converter={StaticResource StatusColor}}"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                        </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Message}"
                                                   FontSize="11" Foreground="#666"
                                                   TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,2,0,0">
                                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Message}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </TextBlock.Style>
                                        </TextBlock>
                                        <TextBlock Margin="0,2,0,0"
                                                   FontSize="10" Foreground="#AAAAAA"
                                                   TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                            <Run Text="Required for: "/>
                                            <Run Text="{Binding RequiredFor}"/>
                                        </TextBlock>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                </ItemsControl>
            </Border>

            <!-- ── Note ── -->
            <TextBlock FontSize="11" Foreground="#888" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                Studio 5000 and the Logix Designer SDK are licensed vendor software.
                Detection uses registry keys; exact keys and version requirements are subject to change.
                Contact your Rockwell Automation vendor or IT administrator for installation guidance.
            </TextBlock>

        </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

    </DockPanel>
</Window>

## What was implemented (commit `1588b13`)

### Critical workflow fixes
| Issue | Fix |
|---|---|
| `git pull` failure continued into restore | `RunProcessAsync` now returns exit code; `PullAndRestoreAsync` checks it and **aborts** with a clear message if nonzero |

- **`IsL5xGitConfigured`** — drives a yellow warning card when l5xgit is not configured
- **`OpenSettingsCommand`** — `⚙ Settings` button in the top bar
- **First-run**: Settings window opens automatically when l5xgit path is empty

- **`SpacedStackPanel`** — custom panel with a `Spacing` DP (fixes the pre-existing `Spacing=` build errors that prevented the scaffold from compiling)
- **Publish profile** — `Properties/PublishProfiles/win-x64-selfcontained.pubxml` for self-contained win-x64 builds

I need to expose the updated path back through the SettingsWindow's ViewModel property so MainViewModel can read it after the dialog closes.

3. **`placeholder-text`**: I'm implementing a WPF-compatible placeholder for the commit message TextBox using a Grid with an overlaid TextBlock that binds to the TextBox's Text property.

4. **`cancellation`**: I'll add a CancellationTokenSource to MainViewModel and a Cancel button in the UI, since CommitAsync and PullAndRestoreAsync already support cancellation tokens.

5. **`log-autoscroll-fix`**: The LogScrollViewer reference is already defined in MainWindow.xaml.cs, so I just need to verify it's still in the XAML markup.

6. **`readme-update`**: I'll update the README to document what's now implemented.

For the settings auto-rescan, I'm thinking through whether to trigger RescanAsync in the SettingsViewModel constructor or use a separate Initialize method called from the window code-behind after InitializeComponent completes, since doing it in the constructor isn't ideal.

For the settings path roundtrip, I need to expose the final l5xgit path from SettingsWindow as a public property so that when the dialog closes, MainViewModel can read back the updated path and refresh L5xGitExePath accordingly.

<Window x:Class="ABLogixGitManager.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.ViewModels"
        xmlns:conv="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Converters"
        xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Controls"
        Title="AB Logix Git Manager"
        Width="960" Height="680"
        MinWidth="780" MinHeight="520"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen">

    <Window.DataContext>
        <vm:MainViewModel/>
    </Window.DataContext>

    <Window.Resources>
        <conv:BoolInverterConverter x:Key="BoolInverter"/>
    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             TOP BAR  —  title + l5xgit.exe path
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#1E1E2E" Padding="14,9">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="🔧" FontSize="16" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="AB Logix Git Manager"
                               Foreground="White" FontSize="15" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                <!-- l5xgit.exe path control -->
                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe:" Foreground="#AAAAAA" FontSize="12" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBox x:Name="L5xGitPathBox"
                             Text="{Binding L5xGitExePath, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                             Width="300"
                             Background="#2D2D3F" Foreground="#E0E0E0"
                             BorderBrush="#555566" Padding="6,4"
                             FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                             VerticalContentAlignment="Center"
                             ToolTip="Full path to l5xgit.exe (built from ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools)"/>
                    <Button Content="Browse"
                            Click="BrowseL5xGit_Click"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="Save"
                            Command="{Binding SaveL5xGitPathCommand}"
                            Background="#2EA043" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="⚙ Settings"
                            Command="{Binding OpenSettingsCommand}"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             STATUS BAR  —  bottom
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#F3F3F3"
                BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0" Padding="12,4">
            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12">
                    <TextBlock.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                            <Setter Property="Text" Value="Ready"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#444"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Text" Value="⏳  Operation in progress…"/>
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#B36A00"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </TextBlock.Style>
                </TextBlock>
                <ProgressBar IsIndeterminate="True" Width="120" Height="10"
                             VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <ProgressBar.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="ProgressBar">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </ProgressBar.Style>
                </ProgressBar>
                <Button Content="✕ Cancel"
                        Command="{Binding CancelOperationCommand}"
                        Background="#C62828" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                        Padding="8,3" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand">
                    <Button.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="Button">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </Button.Style>
                    <Button.Template>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                            <Border x:Name="border" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                    CornerRadius="3" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                                <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            </Border>
                            <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                    <Setter TargetName="border" Property="Opacity" Value="0.85"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Button.Template>
                </Button>
            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             MAIN AREA  —  left list + right detail
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Grid>
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="230" MinWidth="160"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="4"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                 LEFT PANEL  —  repo list
            ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
            <DockPanel Grid.Column="0" Background="#F7F7F7">

                <!-- Add button -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Padding="10,8"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                    <Button Content="+ Add Repo"
                            Command="{Binding AddRepoCommand}"
                            Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"/>
                </Border>

                <!-- Edit / Remove buttons -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Padding="8,6"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">
                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                        <Button Content="Edit"
                                Command="{Binding EditRepoCommand}"
                                Style="{StaticResource NeutralButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                        <Button Content="Remove"
                                Command="{Binding RemoveRepoCommand}"
                                Style="{StaticResource DangerButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Repo list -->
                <ListBox ItemsSource="{Binding Repos}"
                         SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedRepo}"
                         BorderThickness="0"
                         Background="Transparent"
                         ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                    <ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                        <Style TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
                            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#DDEEFF"/>
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#EEF5FF"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                    <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <Border Padding="10,8"
                                    BorderBrush="#E5E5E5" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}"
                                               FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13"
                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding AcdFilePath}"
                                               FontSize="10" Foreground="#888"
                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                               Margin="0,2,0,0"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                </ListBox>
            </DockPanel>

            <!-- Splitter -->
            <GridSplitter Grid.Column="1" Width="4"
                          HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" Background="#DDDDDD"/>

            <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                 RIGHT PANEL  —  actions + log
            ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
            <DockPanel Grid.Column="2">

                <!-- Log panel (fixed at bottom) -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#1E1E1E" Height="180">
                    <DockPanel>
                        <!-- Log toolbar -->
                        <DockPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="10,6">
                            <TextBlock Text="OUTPUT LOG"
                                       Foreground="#888888" FontSize="10"
                                       FontWeight="Bold" FontFamily="Consolas"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            <Button Content="Clear"
                                    Command="{Binding ClearLogCommand}"
                                    DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                    Background="#3A3A3A" Foreground="#BBBBBB"
                                    BorderThickness="0" Padding="8,2"
                                    FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                        </DockPanel>

                        <!-- Log text (auto-scrolls via code-behind) -->
                        <ScrollViewer x:Name="LogScrollViewer"
                                      VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                      HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                            <TextBox x:Name="LogTextBox"
                                     Text="{Binding LogOutput, Mode=OneWay}"
                                     IsReadOnly="True"
                                     Background="Transparent"
                                     Foreground="#90EE90"
                                     FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                                     BorderThickness="0"
                                     TextWrapping="NoWrap"
                                     Padding="10,4"/>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </DockPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Action area (scrollable) -->
                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" Background="#FAFAFA">
                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Margin="20,16,20,16" Spacing="14">

                        <!-- ·····  Setup warning when l5xgit.exe is not configured  ····· -->
                        <Border>
                            <Border.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="Border" BasedOn="{StaticResource Card}">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#FFF8E1"/>
                                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#FFD54F"/>
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsL5xGitConfigured}" Value="False">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </Border.Style>
                            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="10">
                                <TextBlock Text="⚠️" FontSize="18" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe not configured" FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13" Foreground="#6D4C00"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#6D4C00" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Browse to l5xgit.exe above and click Save, or open ⚙ Settings to check all dependencies.
                                        Commit and Restore are disabled until configured.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                        </Border>

                        <!-- ·····  PLACEHOLDER when nothing selected  ····· -->
                        <TextBlock HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,40,0,0"
                                   TextAlignment="Center" Foreground="#AAAAAA">
                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </TextBlock.Style>
                            <Run Text="Select a repo from the list" FontSize="14" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                            <LineBreak/>
                            <Run Text="or click  + Add Repo  to get started." FontSize="12"/>
                        </TextBlock>

                        <!-- ·····  CONTENT when a repo is selected  ····· -->
                        <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="14">
                            <controls:SpacedStackPanel.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="{x:Type controls:SpacedStackPanel}">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </controls:SpacedStackPanel.Style>

                            <!-- Repo info card -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Background="#F0F4FF">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.Name}"
                                               FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#1E1E2E"/>
                                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="ACD:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.AcdFilePath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="Repo:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.GitRepoPath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <!-- ── COMMIT CARD ── -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="10">
                                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                               Text="📤  COMMIT ACD TO GIT"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#666" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Exports the ACD, converts to L5X, explodes to XML/ST files, then
                                        stages and commits all changes to the git repository.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding CommitMessage, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                             AcceptsReturn="True"
                                             Height="80"
                                             TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                             VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             FontSize="13"
                                             BorderBrush="#C0C0C0"
                                             IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                    <Button Content="  ↑  Commit to Git  "
                                            Command="{Binding CommitCommand}"
                                            Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <!-- ── PULL & RESTORE CARD ── -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="10">
                                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                               Text="📥  PULL & RESTORE ACD"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#666" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Pulls the latest changes from the remote repository, then implodes
                                        the exploded files and converts back to a Logix ACD file.
                                        The existing ACD will be overwritten. Any backup behavior depends
                                        on the external l5xgit tool and has not been validated by this
                                        application. Restore will not proceed if git pull fails.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                    <Button Content="  ↓  Pull & Restore ACD  "
                                            Command="{Binding PullAndRestoreCommand}"
                                            Style="{StaticResource SuccessButton}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                        </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                </ScrollViewer>

            </DockPanel>
        </Grid>
    </DockPanel>
</Window>

<Window x:Class="ABLogixGitManager.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.ViewModels"
        xmlns:conv="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Converters"
        xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Controls"
        Title="AB Logix Git Manager"
        Width="960" Height="680"
        MinWidth="780" MinHeight="520"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen">

    <Window.DataContext>
        <vm:MainViewModel/>
    </Window.DataContext>

    <Window.Resources>
        <conv:BoolInverterConverter x:Key="BoolInverter"/>
    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             TOP BAR  —  title + l5xgit.exe path
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#1E1E2E" Padding="14,9">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="🔧" FontSize="16" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="AB Logix Git Manager"
                               Foreground="White" FontSize="15" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                <!-- l5xgit.exe path control -->
                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe:" Foreground="#AAAAAA" FontSize="12" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBox x:Name="L5xGitPathBox"
                             Text="{Binding L5xGitExePath, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                             Width="300"
                             Background="#2D2D3F" Foreground="#E0E0E0"
                             BorderBrush="#555566" Padding="6,4"
                             FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                             VerticalContentAlignment="Center"
                             ToolTip="Full path to l5xgit.exe (built from ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools)"/>
                    <Button Content="Browse"
                            Click="BrowseL5xGit_Click"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="Save"
                            Command="{Binding SaveL5xGitPathCommand}"
                            Background="#2EA043" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="⚙ Settings"
                            Command="{Binding OpenSettingsCommand}"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             STATUS BAR  —  bottom
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

                BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0" Padding="12,4">
            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12">

                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#B36A00"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </TextBlock.Style>
                </TextBlock>
                <ProgressBar IsIndeterminate="True" Width="120" Height="10"
                             VerticalAlignment="Center">

                        <Style TargetType="ProgressBar">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>

                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </ProgressBar.Style>

                        Padding="8,3" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand">
                    <Button.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="Button">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </Button.Style>
                    <Button.Template>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                            <Border x:Name="border" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                    CornerRadius="3" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                                <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>

                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                    <Setter TargetName="border" Property="Opacity" Value="0.85"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Button.Template>
                </Button>
            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="230" MinWidth="160"/>

                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>

                <!-- Add button -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Padding="10,8"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                    <Button Content="+ Add Repo"
                            Command="{Binding AddRepoCommand}"

                <!-- Edit / Remove buttons -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Padding="8,6"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">
                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                        <Button Content="Edit"
                                Command="{Binding EditRepoCommand}"
                                Style="{StaticResource NeutralButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                        <Button Content="Remove"

                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>

                </Border>

                <!-- Repo list -->

                    <ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                        <Style TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
                            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#DDEEFF"/>

                        </Style>
                    </ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                    <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <Border Padding="10,8"
                                    BorderBrush="#E5E5E5" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}"
                                               FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13"

                            </Border>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                </ListBox>
            </DockPanel>

            <!-- Splitter -->
            <GridSplitter Grid.Column="1" Width="4"
                          HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" Background="#DDDDDD"/>

            <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                 RIGHT PANEL  —  actions + log
            ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
            <DockPanel Grid.Column="2">

                <!-- Log panel (fixed at bottom) -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#1E1E1E" Height="180">
                    <DockPanel>
                        <!-- Log toolbar -->
                        <DockPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="10,6">
                            <TextBlock Text="OUTPUT LOG"
                                       Foreground="#888888" FontSize="10"
                                       FontWeight="Bold" FontFamily="Consolas"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            <Button Content="Clear"
                                    Command="{Binding ClearLogCommand}"
                                    DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                    Background="#3A3A3A" Foreground="#BBBBBB"
                                    BorderThickness="0" Padding="8,2"
                                    FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                        </DockPanel>

                        <!-- Log text (auto-scrolls via code-behind) -->
                        <ScrollViewer x:Name="LogScrollViewer"
                                      VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                      HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                            <TextBox x:Name="LogTextBox"
                                     Text="{Binding LogOutput, Mode=OneWay}"
                                     IsReadOnly="True"
                                     Background="Transparent"
                                     Foreground="#90EE90"
                                     FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                                     BorderThickness="0"
                                     TextWrapping="NoWrap"
                                     Padding="10,4"/>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </DockPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Action area (scrollable) -->
                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" Background="#FAFAFA">
                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Margin="20,16,20,16" Spacing="14">

                        <!-- ·····  Setup warning when l5xgit.exe is not configured  ····· -->
                        <Border>
                            <Border.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="Border" BasedOn="{StaticResource Card}">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#FFF8E1"/>
                                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#FFD54F"/>
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsL5xGitConfigured}" Value="False">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </Border.Style>
                            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="10">
                                <TextBlock Text="⚠️" FontSize="18" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe not configured" FontWeight="SemiBold" FontSize="13" Foreground="#6D4C00"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#6D4C00" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Browse to l5xgit.exe above and click Save, or open ⚙ Settings to check all dependencies.
                                        Commit and Restore are disabled until configured.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                        </Border>

                        <!-- ·····  PLACEHOLDER when nothing selected  ····· -->
                        <TextBlock HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,40,0,0"
                                   TextAlignment="Center" Foreground="#AAAAAA">
                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </TextBlock.Style>
                            <Run Text="Select a repo from the list" FontSize="14" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                            <LineBreak/>
                            <Run Text="or click  + Add Repo  to get started." FontSize="12"/>
                        </TextBlock>

                        <!-- ·····  CONTENT when a repo is selected  ····· -->
                        <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="14">
                            <controls:SpacedStackPanel.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="{x:Type controls:SpacedStackPanel}">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding SelectedRepo}" Value="{x:Null}">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                        </DataTrigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </controls:SpacedStackPanel.Style>

                            <!-- Repo info card -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}" Background="#F0F4FF">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.Name}"
                                               FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#1E1E2E"/>
                                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="ACD:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.AcdFilePath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4">
                                        <TextBlock Text="Repo:" Foreground="#666" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedRepo.GitRepoPath}"
                                                   Foreground="#333" FontSize="11"
                                                   FontFamily="Consolas"
                                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <!-- ── COMMIT CARD ── -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="10">
                                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                               Text="📤  COMMIT ACD TO GIT"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#666" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Exports the ACD, converts to L5X, explodes to XML/ST files, then
                                        stages and commits all changes to the git repository.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                    <TextBox Text="{Binding CommitMessage, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                             AcceptsReturn="True"
                                             Height="80"
                                             TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                             VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             FontSize="13"
                                             BorderBrush="#C0C0C0"
                                             IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                    <Button Content="  ↑  Commit to Git  "
                                            Command="{Binding CommitCommand}"
                                            Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                            <!-- ── PULL & RESTORE CARD ── -->
                            <Border Style="{StaticResource Card}">
                                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Spacing="10">
                                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                               Text="📥  PULL & RESTORE ACD"/>
                                    <TextBlock FontSize="12" Foreground="#666" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                        Pulls the latest changes from the remote repository, then implodes
                                        the exploded files and converts back to a Logix ACD file.
                                        The existing ACD will be overwritten. Any backup behavior depends
                                        on the external l5xgit tool and has not been validated by this
                                        application. Restore will not proceed if git pull fails.
                                    </TextBlock>
                                    <Button Content="  ↓  Pull & Restore ACD  "
                                            Command="{Binding PullAndRestoreCommand}"
                                            Style="{StaticResource SuccessButton}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                        </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                </ScrollViewer>

            </DockPanel>
        </Grid>
    </DockPanel>
</Window>
