<Window x:Class="ABLogixGitManager.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.ViewModels"
        xmlns:conv="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Converters"
        xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Controls"
        Title="AB Logix Git Manager"
        Width="960" Height="680"
        MinWidth="780" MinHeight="520"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen">

    <Window.DataContext>
        <vm:MainViewModel/>
    </Window.DataContext>

    <Window.Resources>
        <conv:BoolInverterConverter x:Key="BoolInverter"/>
    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             TOP BAR  —  title + l5xgit.exe path
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#1E1E2E" Padding="14,9">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="🔧" FontSize="16" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="AB Logix Git Manager"
                               Foreground="White" FontSize="15" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                <!-- l5xgit.exe path control -->
                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe:" Foreground="#AAAAAA" FontSize="12" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBox x:Name="L5xGitPathBox"
                             Text="{Binding L5xGitExePath, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                             Width="300"
                             Background="#2D2D3F" Foreground="#E0E0E0"
                             BorderBrush="#555566" Padding="6,4"
                             FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                             VerticalContentAlignment="Center"
                             ToolTip="Full path to l5xgit.exe (built from ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools)"/>
                    <Button Content="Browse"
                            Click="BrowseL5xGit_Click"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="Save"
                            Command="{Binding SaveL5xGitPathCommand}"
                            Background="#2EA043" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="⚙ Settings"
                            Command="{Binding OpenSettingsCommand}"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             STATUS BAR  —  bottom
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#F3F3F3"
                BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0" Padding="12,4">
            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12">
                    <TextBlock.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                            <Setter Property="Text" Value="Ready"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#444"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Text" Value="⏳  Operation in progress…"/>
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#B36A00"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </TextBlock.Style>
                </TextBlock>
                <ProgressBar IsIndeterminate="True" Width="120" Height="10"
                             VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <ProgressBar.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="ProgressBar">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </ProgressBar.Style>
                </ProgressBar>
                <Button Content="✕ Cancel"
                        Command="{Binding CancelOperationCommand}"
                        Background="#C62828" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                        Padding="8,3" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand">
                    <Button.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="Button">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </Button.Style>
                    <Button.Template>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                            <Border x:Name="border" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                    CornerRadius="3" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                                <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            </Border>
                            <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                    <Setter TargetName="border" Property="Opacity" Value="0.85"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Button.Template>
                </Button>
            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             MAIN AREA  —  left list + right detail
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Grid>
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="230" MinWidth="160"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="4"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                 LEFT PANEL  —  repo list
            ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
            <DockPanel Grid.Column="0" Background="#F7F7F7">

                <!-- Add button -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Padding="10,8"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                    <Button Content="+ Add Repo"
                            Command="{Binding AddRepoCommand}"
                            Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"/>
                </Border>

                <!-- Edit / Remove buttons -->
                <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Padding="8,6"
                        Background="#EEEEEE" BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">
                    <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
                        <Button Content="Edit"
                                Command="{Binding EditRepoCommand}"
                                Style="{StaticResource NeutralButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                        <Button Content="Remove"
                                Command="{Binding RemoveRepoCommand}"
                                Style="{StaticResource DangerButton}"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Repo list -->
                <ListBox ItemsSource="{Binding Repos}"
                         SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedRepo}"
                         BorderThickness="0"
                         Background="Transparent"

                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            IsEnabled="{Binding IsBusy, Converter={StaticResource BoolInverter}}"/>
                                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                            </Border>

                        </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                    </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
                </ScrollViewer>

            </DockPanel>
        </Grid>
    </DockPanel>
</Window>

<Window x:Class="ABLogixGitManager.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.ViewModels"
        xmlns:conv="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Converters"
        xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:ABLogixGitManager.Controls"
        Title="AB Logix Git Manager"
        Width="960" Height="680"
        MinWidth="780" MinHeight="520"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen">

    <Window.DataContext>
        <vm:MainViewModel/>
    </Window.DataContext>

    <Window.Resources>
        <conv:BoolInverterConverter x:Key="BoolInverter"/>
    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             TOP BAR  —  title + l5xgit.exe path
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#1E1E2E" Padding="14,9">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="🔧" FontSize="16" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="AB Logix Git Manager"
                               Foreground="White" FontSize="15" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>

                <!-- l5xgit.exe path control -->
                <controls:SpacedStackPanel Grid.Column="2" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="6">
                    <TextBlock Text="l5xgit.exe:" Foreground="#AAAAAA" FontSize="12" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBox x:Name="L5xGitPathBox"
                             Text="{Binding L5xGitExePath, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                             Width="300"
                             Background="#2D2D3F" Foreground="#E0E0E0"
                             BorderBrush="#555566" Padding="6,4"
                             FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="11"
                             VerticalContentAlignment="Center"
                             ToolTip="Full path to l5xgit.exe (built from ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools)"/>
                    <Button Content="Browse"
                            Click="BrowseL5xGit_Click"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="Save"
                            Command="{Binding SaveL5xGitPathCommand}"
                            Background="#2EA043" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                    <Button Content="⚙ Settings"
                            Command="{Binding OpenSettingsCommand}"
                            Background="#3C3C50" Foreground="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="0"
                            Padding="8,4" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand"/>
                </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             STATUS BAR  —  bottom
        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

                BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0" Padding="12,4">
            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8">
                <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="12">
                    <TextBlock.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                            <Setter Property="Text" Value="Ready"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#444"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Text" Value="⏳  Operation in progress…"/>
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#B36A00"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </TextBlock.Style>
                </TextBlock>
                <ProgressBar IsIndeterminate="True" Width="120" Height="10"
                             VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <ProgressBar.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="ProgressBar">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </ProgressBar.Style>
                </ProgressBar>

                        Command="{Binding CancelOperationCommand}"
                        Background="#C62828" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"
                        Padding="8,3" FontSize="11" Cursor="Hand">

                        <Style TargetType="Button">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsBusy}" Value="True">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </Button.Style>
                    <Button.Template>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                            <Border x:Name="border" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                    CornerRadius="3" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                                <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                            </Border>
                            <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                    <Setter TargetName="border" Property="Opacity" Value="0.85"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Button.Template>
                </Button>
            </controls:SpacedStackPanel>
        </Border>

        ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="230" MinWidth="160"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="4"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>

                            <controls:SpacedStackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="10">

# AB Logix Git Manager

A Windows WPF front end for managing Allen-Bradley Logix ACD projects with Git
through Rockwell Automation's
[`l5xgit`](https://github.com/RockwellAutomation/ra-logix-designer-vcs-custom-tools)
tools.

> **Current status: pre-release scaffold.** The repository does not yet produce
> a validated GitHub Releases artifact or bundle its external tools. The
> dependency center detects tools but does not automate installation or repair.
> See the [Release acceptance criteria](plan.md#release-acceptance-criteria) in
> `plan.md` before advertising a zero-dependency release artifact.

## Planned release experience (not yet validated)

The release target is one download from GitHub Releases that starts without an
installer, an existing .NET installation, or administrator rights:

- Ship the application with its own self-contained .NET runtime.
- Prefer a self-contained, single-file Windows executable only after validating
  WPF and all required native/content files. If a literal one-file executable is
  unreliable, ship a self-extracting launcher or clearly documented portable
  package while retaining the one-download/no-install experience.
- Show each dependency as **Ready**, **Missing**, **Incompatible**,
  **Installing**, **Failed**, or **Admin Required**, with **Install Now** or
  **Repair** where automated action is legal and technically reliable.
- Prefer pinned and verified prebuilt VCS tool binaries so ordinary release
  users do not need .NET SDK 10. Building or updating those tools from source is
  a fallback/developer path, subject to redistribution and licensing review.

The bundled application runtime only starts this application; it is not the
.NET SDK needed to compile upstream tools. Studio 5000 and the Logix Designer
SDK remain licensed vendor software and may require vendor media or login,
activation, administrator approval, a reboot, or organizational IT deployment.
The application may guide or launch those steps but will not promise silent,
no-admin installation. UAC is reserved for privileged external installation or
Studio integration—not for launching the manager or using its basic functions.

See [`plan.md`](plan.md) for the canonical engineering plan, feasibility gates,
and acceptance criteria.

## Current status

Implemented:

- Add, edit, remove, and persist ACD-to-repository mappings in
  `%APPDATA%\ABLogixGitManager\config.json`.
- Write or overwrite the `<AcdName>_L5xGit.yml` sidecar before an operation.
- Invoke `l5xgit commit --acd ...`, passing the commit message on standard input.
- Invoke `git -C ... pull` then `l5xgit restoreacd --acd ...`, answering `y` to
  the overwrite prompt — **restore is aborted if `git pull` fails**.
- Validate `l5xgit.exe`, ACD file, and git repo paths before each operation with
  distinct error messages for each missing path.
- Use `ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList` for all subprocess arguments (path-safe).
- Cancellable operations: a **✕ Cancel** button appears in the status bar during
  any in-progress commit or restore.
- Stream subprocess stdout/stderr into the application log with timestamps.
- **Settings / Dependency Center** (⚙ Settings button in the toolbar): scans for
  Git, Rockwell VCS tools, .NET SDK 10, Studio 5000, and Logix Designer SDK;
  shows each as **Ready**, **Missing**, **Incompatible**, or **Failed** with a
  version string and diagnostic message. Rescan runs automatically when Settings
  opens.
- Setup warning card in the main window when `l5xgit.exe` is not yet configured.
- Settings window opens automatically on first run (when no `l5xgit.exe` path
  has been saved).
- Self-contained `win-x64` publish profile at
  `src/ABLogixGitManager/Properties/PublishProfiles/win-x64-selfcontained.pubxml`.

Not yet validated or implemented:

- Clean-machine testing of the self-contained publish artifact (required before
  release).
- Install/repair automation for Git or VCS tools; vendor-guided paths for
  Studio 5000 and the SDK.
- Bundled or verified `l5xgit`/Git binaries; provenance pinning and integrity
  checks for downloads.
- Signed release artifact, GitHub Actions release workflow, or smoke-test suite.

## Build and run (contributors only)

Use Windows with the .NET 10 SDK. End-to-end ACD operations additionally need a
compatible Studio 5000/Logix Designer SDK installation, a separately supplied
`l5xgit.exe`, and `git` on `PATH`.

```powershell
dotnet restore .\src\ABLogixGitManager\ABLogixGitManager.csproj
dotnet build   .\src\ABLogixGitManager\ABLogixGitManager.csproj -c Release
dotnet run --project .\src\ABLogixGitManager\ABLogixGitManager.csproj
```

For the current UI, click **⚙ Settings** to run the dependency scan. Then
browse to `l5xgit.exe`, save its path, and add a mapping with a friendly name,
ACD path, and Git/exploded-directory path.

To produce a self-contained executable (requires clean-machine validation before
release):

```powershell
dotnet publish .\src\ABLogixGitManager\ABLogixGitManager.csproj `
  /p:PublishProfile=win-x64-selfcontained
# Output: src\ABLogixGitManager\publish\win-x64\ABLogixGitManager.exe
```

> **Restore warning:** The existing ACD is overwritten without a manager-level
> backup prompt. Any backup behavior depends on the external `l5xgit` tool and
> has not been validated by this repository. Restore will not proceed if
> `git pull` fails.

- `done`: Todo is complete
- `blocked`: Todo cannot proceed (document why in description)

I'm hooking into the `ContentRendered` event of the main window to defer the settings dialog until after the window is fully rendered. Since `base.OnStartup` creates the window from the `StartupUri`, `MainWindow` should be available by that point, so this approach should work without the null reference issues. The better approach is to subscribe to the `Activated` event instead, which fires after the first window is shown and `MainWindow` is properly initialized. <technical_details>
- **WPF `StackPanel.Spacing`**: Not a native WPF property (it's UWP/WinUI only). Solution: `SpacedStackPanel` subclass with custom `MeasureOverride`/`ArrangeOverride` that adds spacing gaps between children without mutating child margins. Children with `Visibility.Collapsed` are skipped.
- **WPF `TextBox.PlaceholderText`**: Not a WPF property. Solution: Grid overlay with a `TextBlock` that uses a `DataTrigger` on `CommitMessage == ""` to show/hide.
- **`Run.Text` binding defaults to `TwoWay`**: Inside a `TextBlock`, `Run.Text` binding mode defaults to `TwoWay`. Read-only properties on the VM will crash with `XamlParseException`. Fix: always add `Mode=OneWay` to `Run.Text` bindings.
- **`App.OnStartup` — `MainWindow` is null**: `StartupUri` creates the window asynchronously after `OnStartup` returns. Accessing `MainWindow` during `OnStartup` throws `NullReferenceException`. Use `Application.Activated` event (fires once the first window becomes foreground) to safely reference `MainWindow`.
- **`ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList` vs `Arguments`**: `.ArgumentList` handles paths with spaces correctly without manual quoting. Each argument is a separate string item.
- **git pull abort**: `RunProcessAsync` now returns `int` exit code. `PullAndRestoreAsync` checks it and returns early with an error message if nonzero — prevents restoring from stale content.
- **NuGet restore requires explicit source**: `dotnet restore` on this machine requires `--source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json` explicitly (no default NuGet.config pointing to nuget.org).
- **Worktree deregistration**: `git worktree remove` successfully deregistered the worktree from git tracking even though the physical directory couldn't be deleted (VS Code CWD lock). The merge to `main` was clean.
- **`DependencyCheckerService` registry probes**: Checks both `SOFTWARE\Rockwell Automation\*` and `SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Rockwell Automation\*` paths. Returns version from `Version` or `InstallVersion` value, or `"(version unknown)"` if key exists but has no version value.
- **`SpacedStackPanel` styling**: When a `SpacedStackPanel` has an inline `<Style>` via element syntax, the `TargetType` must be `{x:Type controls:SpacedStackPanel}`, not `TargetType="StackPanel"`, otherwise the style silently doesn't apply or causes errors.
</technical_details>

## Logging Standards

Every public service method, ViewModel command, and failure path **must** write to `AppLogger`.
Failing to log is treated the same as failing to handle an error — both hide root causes.

- **Info**: Log at the start and successful end of every significant operation (config load/save, process launch, scan result, UI action that mutates state).
- **Warn**: Log every failed validation, missing file, nonzero exit code, and unexpected-but-recoverable condition.
- **Error**: Log every caught exception with the full `Exception` object (not just `.Message`). `AppLogger.Error("description", ex)` includes type, message, and stack trace.
- **Never swallow exceptions silently.** A `catch` block that does nothing is a bug. Either log and rethrow, or log and surface a message to the user.
- `AppLogger` is static, thread-safe, and never throws. It can be called from constructors, callbacks, async continuations, and background threads without guards.
- The log file path is `%APPDATA%\ABLogixGitManager\logs\app-YYYY-MM-DD.log`. Include this path in error dialogs so users can find it.
- `App.xaml.cs` registers three global exception handlers: `DispatcherUnhandledException`, `AppDomain.CurrentDomain.UnhandledException`, and `TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException`. These are the safety net; do not rely on them as the only log point.

## Documentation Standards

- **XML `<summary>` doc comments are required** on all public types and public/protected members. This includes classes, records, enums, properties, and methods.
- Private helpers and backing fields need comments only when the implementation is non-obvious or carries a non-obvious constraint.
- Comments explain *why*, not *what*. Do not restate the code.
- When binding `Run.Text` in XAML to a read-only (get-only) property, **always add `Mode=OneWay`**. `Run.Text` has `BindsTwoWayByDefault = true` in its DP metadata; omitting the mode causes a `XamlParseException` at startup.
- WPF-incompatible properties that look valid: `StackPanel.Spacing` (UWP/WinUI only), `TextBox.PlaceholderText` (UWP/WinUI only). Use the custom `SpacedStackPanel` control and the Grid-overlay watermark pattern respectively.
- Build process arguments with `ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList`, not `ProcessStartInfo.Arguments`. The former handles paths with spaces without manual quoting and prevents injection.

## Completion Standard

- Ask whether the solution addresses the root cause, remains simple, preserves safety boundaries, and would withstand skeptical review.
- Summarize the behavior changed, files affected, verification evidence, and residual risk. Mention unrelated pre-existing failures without attempting to fix them.

# AB Logix Git Manager Copilot Instructions

## Operating Workflow

- Treat non-trivial work as a planned workflow. Before editing, identify the concrete behavior, owning code path, smallest viable change, and focused verification that can disprove the approach.
- For work with three or more steps or an architectural decision, maintain a checklist in `tasks/todo.md`. Keep it current as work proceeds and add a short review section with the validation performed and any remaining risks.
- Start from the named file, symbol, failing behavior, test, or command. Read only enough nearby code to form a falsifiable hypothesis, then make the smallest grounded edit.
- After the first substantive edit, immediately run the narrowest available executable check. Repair local failures and rerun that check before widening the scope.
- Use read-only subagents for broad repository exploration, independent review, or parallel research. Give each subagent one focused task and keep implementation ownership in the main agent unless explicitly delegated.
- If evidence invalidates the plan, stop, update the plan, and continue from the newly identified controlling code path.
- Do not declare work complete without verification. Report commands actually run, their result, and anything that could not be validated in the current environment.
- After a user correction, record the generalized lesson in `tasks/lessons.md` so future work does not repeat it.

## Repository Truth And Scope

- Read `README.md` for the current user-facing status and `plan.md` for the canonical product contract, feasibility gates, and acceptance criteria.
- Keep implemented behavior distinct from planned behavior. Verify claims against the current source; never describe a roadmap item as available because it appears in `plan.md`.
- This repository is an early Windows WPF scaffold targeting `net10.0-windows`. Do not assume release packaging, dependency discovery, bundled tools, automated tests, or clean-machine validation exists unless the repository contains evidence.
- Prefer the smallest change that satisfies the request. Do not implement adjacent roadmap items, reformat unrelated code, or overwrite user changes.
- Preserve existing public behavior and configuration compatibility unless the task explicitly requires a breaking change. Call out migrations when changing `%APPDATA%\ABLogixGitManager\config.json` or persisted model shapes.

## Architecture And Coding Conventions

- Follow the existing WPF MVVM structure: XAML and code-behind own presentation concerns, view models own UI state and commands, services own persistence and external-process integration, and models remain simple data contracts.
- Use CommunityToolkit.Mvvm attributes and generated commands/properties consistently with nearby code. Avoid adding another MVVM framework or dependency when the existing stack is sufficient.
- Keep nullable reference types enabled and resolve warnings rather than suppressing them without a documented reason.
- Use clear C# with guard clauses, descriptive names, async APIs for I/O, and cancellation propagation for long-running operations. Keep UI-bound updates on the WPF dispatcher and avoid blocking the UI thread.
- Prefer standard .NET APIs and existing dependencies. Add a package only when it materially simplifies a verified requirement, and document why it is needed.

# Lessons Learned

Generalised lessons captured from corrections and bugs found during development.
Apply these to all future work in this repository.

---

## WPF: Run.Text binding defaults to TwoWay

**Discovered:** Startup `XamlParseException` when binding `Run.Text` to a read-only property.

**Root cause:** `Run.Text` is a DependencyProperty whose metadata has `BindsTwoWayByDefault = true`.
When the target property has no setter, WPF throws at startup — not at the binding call site.

**Rule:** Always add `Mode=OneWay` to any `Run.Text` binding that targets a get-only property.
```xml
<!-- BAD — crashes if RequiredFor has no setter -->
<Run Text="{Binding RequiredFor}"/>

<!-- CORRECT -->
<Run Text="{Binding RequiredFor, Mode=OneWay}"/>
```

**Note:** `TextBlock.Text` defaults to `OneWay`, so this issue is specific to `Run.Text` and
other DPs with `BindsTwoWayByDefault = true` (e.g., `TextBox.Text`).

---

## WPF: MainWindow is null during App.OnStartup

**Discovered:** `NullReferenceException` accessing `Application.Current.MainWindow` inside `OnStartup`.

**Root cause:** When `StartupUri` is used, the window is created **after** `OnStartup` returns.
`MainWindow` is `null` throughout `OnStartup`.

**Rule:** Never access `MainWindow` inside `OnStartup`.
Use `Application.Activated` (fires once, after the first window becomes foreground) to safely
reference `MainWindow`:
```csharp
EventHandler? handler = null;
handler = (_, _) =>
{
    Activated -= handler;        // unsubscribe after first fire
    new MyDialog { Owner = MainWindow }.ShowDialog();
};
Activated += handler;
```

---

## WPF-incompatible UWP/WinUI properties

**Discovered:** Build errors on `StackPanel.Spacing=` and `TextBox.PlaceholderText`.

Apply these to all future work in this repository.

---

## WPF: Run.Text binding defaults to TwoWay

**Discovered:** Startup `XamlParseException` when binding `Run.Text` to a read-only property.

**Root cause:** `Run.Text` is a DependencyProperty whose metadata has `BindsTwoWayByDefault = true`.
When the target property has no setter, WPF throws at startup — not at the binding call site.

**Rule:** Always add `Mode=OneWay` to any `Run.Text` binding that targets a get-only property.
```xml
<!-- BAD — crashes if RequiredFor has no setter -->
<Run Text="{Binding RequiredFor}"/>

<!-- CORRECT -->
<Run Text="{Binding RequiredFor, Mode=OneWay}"/>
```

**Note:** `TextBlock.Text` defaults to `OneWay`, so this issue is specific to `Run.Text` and
other DPs with `BindsTwoWayByDefault = true` (e.g., `TextBox.Text`).

---

## WPF: MainWindow is null during App.OnStartup

**Discovered:** `NullReferenceException` accessing `Application.Current.MainWindow` inside `OnStartup`.

**Root cause:** When `StartupUri` is used, the window is created **after** `OnStartup` returns.
`MainWindow` is `null` throughout `OnStartup`.

**Rule:** Never access `MainWindow` inside `OnStartup`.
Use `Application.Activated` (fires once, after the first window becomes foreground) to safely
reference `MainWindow`:
```csharp
EventHandler? handler = null;
handler = (_, _) =>
{
    Activated -= handler;        // unsubscribe after first fire
    new MyDialog { Owner = MainWindow }.ShowDialog();
};
Activated += handler;
```

---

## WPF-incompatible UWP/WinUI properties

**Discovered:** Build errors on `StackPanel.Spacing=` and `TextBox.PlaceholderText`.

**Root cause:** Both are WinUI/UWP-only. WPF's `StackPanel` has no `Spacing` property,
and WPF's `TextBox` has no `PlaceholderText` property.

**Fixes:**
- `StackPanel Spacing="N"` → use `Controls/SpacedStackPanel.cs` (custom panel with `Spacing` DP)
- `TextBox PlaceholderText="..."` → use a `Grid` overlay with a `TextBlock` hidden via `DataTrigger`

Do not use UWP/WinUI property names in WPF XAML even if IntelliSense does not warn.

---

## Logging: every failure path must be logged

**Discovered:** Startup crashes left no trace; the process just silently disappeared.

**Rule:** Every `catch` block must either:
1. Call `AppLogger.Error(description, ex)` and optionally rethrow, **or**
2. Call `AppLogger.Error(description, ex)` and surface a user-visible message.

A silent `catch` is a diagnostic black hole. The global handlers in `App.xaml.cs`
are a safety net, not a substitute for local logging.

**Also:** Log at the start and end of every significant operation (config load, process
launch, scan complete) so the log file can reconstruct what the application was doing
when a crash occurred.

---

## ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList vs Arguments

**Rule:** Always use `ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList.Add(arg)` instead of building an
`Arguments` string. Reasons:
- Handles paths with spaces without manual quoting.
- Prevents accidental shell injection from user-supplied paths.
- Matches the explicit structure of the actual argument list.

```csharp
// BAD
psi.Arguments = $"commit --acd \"{acdPath}\"";   // breaks on paths with spaces

// CORRECT
psi.ArgumentList.Add("commit");
psi.ArgumentList.Add("--acd");
psi.ArgumentList.Add(acdPath);
```

---

## git pull must abort before restore

**Rule:** If `git pull` exits with a nonzero code, the restore step **must not continue**.
Restoring from stale local content would silently overwrite the ACD with an old version.

Always check the exit code and return early with a user-visible error before calling
`l5xgit restoreacd`.

# AB Logix Git Manager Copilot Instructions

## Operating Workflow

- Treat non-trivial work as a planned workflow. Before editing, identify the concrete behavior, owning code path, smallest viable change, and focused verification that can disprove the approach.
- For work with three or more steps or an architectural decision, maintain a checklist in `tasks/todo.md`. Keep it current as work proceeds and add a short review section with the validation performed and any remaining risks.
- Start from the named file, symbol, failing behavior, test, or command. Read only enough nearby code to form a falsifiable hypothesis, then make the smallest grounded edit.
- After the first substantive edit, immediately run the narrowest available executable check. Repair local failures and rerun that check before widening the scope.
- Use read-only subagents for broad repository exploration, independent review, or parallel research. Give each subagent one focused task and keep implementation ownership in the main agent unless explicitly delegated.
- If evidence invalidates the plan, stop, update the plan, and continue from the newly identified controlling code path.
- Do not declare work complete without verification. Report commands actually run, their result, and anything that could not be validated in the current environment.
- After a user correction, record the generalized lesson in `tasks/lessons.md` so future work does not repeat it.

## Repository Truth And Scope

- Read `README.md` for the current user-facing status and `plan.md` for the canonical product contract, feasibility gates, and acceptance criteria.
- Keep implemented behavior distinct from planned behavior. Verify claims against the current source; never describe a roadmap item as available because it appears in `plan.md`.
- This repository is an early Windows WPF scaffold targeting `net10.0-windows`. Do not assume release packaging, dependency discovery, bundled tools, automated tests, or clean-machine validation exists unless the repository contains evidence.
- Prefer the smallest change that satisfies the request. Do not implement adjacent roadmap items, reformat unrelated code, or overwrite user changes.
- Preserve existing public behavior and configuration compatibility unless the task explicitly requires a breaking change. Call out migrations when changing `%APPDATA%\ABLogixGitManager\config.json` or persisted model shapes.

## Architecture And Coding Conventions

- Follow the existing WPF MVVM structure: XAML and code-behind own presentation concerns, view models own UI state and commands, services own persistence and external-process integration, and models remain simple data contracts.
- Use CommunityToolkit.Mvvm attributes and generated commands/properties consistently with nearby code. Avoid adding another MVVM framework or dependency when the existing stack is sufficient.
- Keep nullable reference types enabled and resolve warnings rather than suppressing them without a documented reason.
- Use clear C# with guard clauses, descriptive names, async APIs for I/O, and cancellation propagation for long-running operations. Keep UI-bound updates on the WPF dispatcher and avoid blocking the UI thread.
- Prefer standard .NET APIs and existing dependencies. Add a package only when it materially simplifies a verified requirement, and document why it is needed.
- Comments should explain non-obvious constraints or rationale. XML documentation belongs on public APIs where inputs, outputs, side effects, or edge cases are not evident.

## Process And Data Safety

- Treat ACD overwrite, restore, Git mutation, configuration replacement, downloads, installation, repair, and elevation as safety-sensitive operations.
- Never claim that an ACD backup exists unless this application creates and verifies it or tested external-tool behavior proves it. Preserve explicit overwrite warnings and make recovery behavior truthful.
- Stop dependent operations after a failed prerequisite. In particular, restore must not continue after a failed `git pull`.
- Validate configured executable, ACD, and repository paths before launching work. Distinguish process launch failure, nonzero exit, cancellation, validation failure, and dependency failure in user-visible diagnostics.
- Build process arguments with structured APIs such as `ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList` when practical; do not rely on ad hoc quoting for untrusted or user-selected paths.
- Keep the main application unelevated. Request elevation only for a narrowly scoped external action that demonstrably requires it, with explicit user consent.
- Never embed credentials, vendor media, activation data, tokens, or private download URLs. Do not bypass Studio 5000, Logix Designer SDK, Git, or Rockwell licensing and redistribution requirements.
- Verify downloaded or bundled executables using approved provenance and pinned integrity metadata before execution. Do not promise unattended installation without vendor support and clean-machine evidence.

## Validation

- Scale validation to risk. Use focused unit tests for pure logic and service behavior; add integration tests around process exit handling, cancellation, path validation, and configuration persistence when those areas change.
- For source changes, run the narrowest relevant test first, then build `src/ABLogixGitManager/ABLogixGitManager.csproj` when the environment supports the Windows WPF target.
- Do not treat a successful compile as proof of Studio 5000, Logix Designer SDK, `l5xgit`, Git credential, packaging, or clean-machine behavior. Validate those workflows in a representative Windows environment before making release claims.
- When macOS cannot execute or fully build a Windows-specific path, run all available static checks and explicitly identify the remaining Windows validation instead of implying success.
- Before finishing, inspect the focused diff for unintended changes and confirm documentation still separates current capabilities from planned ones.

## Logging Standards

Every public service method, ViewModel command, and failure path **must** write to `AppLogger`.
Failing to log is treated the same as failing to handle an error — both hide root causes.

- **Info**: Log at the start and successful end of every significant operation (config load/save, process launch, scan result, UI action that mutates state).
- **Warn**: Log every failed validation, missing file, nonzero exit code, and unexpected-but-recoverable condition.

- `AppLogger` is static, thread-safe, and never throws. It can be called from constructors, callbacks, async continuations, and background threads without guards.
- The log file path is `%APPDATA%\ABLogixGitManager\logs\app-YYYY-MM-DD.log`. Include this path in error dialogs so users can find it.
- `App.xaml.cs` registers three global exception handlers: `DispatcherUnhandledException`, `AppDomain.CurrentDomain.UnhandledException`, and `TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException`. These are the safety net; do not rely on them as the only log point.

## Documentation Standards

- **XML `<summary>` doc comments are required** on all public types and public/protected members. This includes classes, records, enums, properties, and methods.
- Private helpers and backing fields need comments only when the implementation is non-obvious or carries a non-obvious constraint.
- Comments explain *why*, not *what*. Do not restate the code.
- When binding `Run.Text` in XAML to a read-only (get-only) property, **always add `Mode=OneWay`**. `Run.Text` has `BindsTwoWayByDefault = true` in its DP metadata; omitting the mode causes a `XamlParseException` at startup.
- WPF-incompatible properties that look valid: `StackPanel.Spacing` (UWP/WinUI only), `TextBox.PlaceholderText` (UWP/WinUI only). Use the custom `SpacedStackPanel` control and the Grid-overlay watermark pattern respectively.
- Build process arguments with `ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList`, not `ProcessStartInfo.Arguments`. The former handles paths with spaces without manual quoting and prevents injection.

## Completion Standard

- Ask whether the solution addresses the root cause, remains simple, preserves safety boundaries, and would withstand skeptical review.
- Summarize the behavior changed, files affected, verification evidence, and residual risk. Mention unrelated pre-existing failures without attempting to fix them.

All done. Commit `08c5265` — here's what changed and why:

---

### Changes made

**`Views/SettingsWindow.xaml`** — Crash fix
`Run.Text` has `BindsTwoWayByDefault = true` in its WPF DP metadata. Binding it to the get-only `RequiredFor` property caused a `XamlParseException` on startup. Fixed with `Mode=OneWay`, with an inline comment explaining the rule so it's never missed again.

**`Services/AppLogger.cs`** — New file
Thread-safe static logger. Writes to `%APPDATA%\ABLogixGitManager\logs\app-YYYY-MM-DD.log`. Uses `[CallerMemberName]` to capture the calling method automatically — no logging framework dependency. Silently discards I/O failures to prevent cascading errors.

**`App.xaml.cs`** — Global exception handlers
Three handlers registered: `DispatcherUnhandledException` (logs + shows dialog with log file path), `AppDomain.CurrentDomain.UnhandledException` (logs background thread crashes), `TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException` (logs silent async failures). All write full stack traces.

**All services + ViewModels** — Logging wired through
`AppConfigService`, `L5xGitCliService`, `DependencyCheckerService`, `MainViewModel`, `SettingsViewModel` all log at operation start/end, on validation failures, and on every exception. XML doc comments added to all previously undocumented public types and members.

**`.github/copilot-instructions.md`** — New Logging Standards + Documentation Standards sections
Enforces: every `catch` must log, `Run.Text` always needs `Mode=OneWay` on read-only properties, `ArgumentList` not `Arguments`, WPF-only alternatives for UWP properties.

**`tasks/lessons.md`** — New file
Captures six specific lessons from this session with code examples.

---

**To find the log file after a crash:** `%APPDATA%\ABLogixGitManager\logs\app-YYYY-MM-DD.log`
